Indian Railways Develops New Vande Bharat Sleeper Train

Indian Railways has developed a new 24-coach Vande Bharat Sleeper train, with a planned rollout for June 2027. A separate 16-coach Vande Bharat train successfully completed a trial run at 180 kmph on the Mathura-Nagda route on October 8, 2026.
